name: Bronze Minotaur
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can’t speak

traits.name: Fire Absorption
traits.text:
Whenever the bronze minotaur is subjected to fire
damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points
equal to the fire damage dealt.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.text:
The bronze minotaur is immune to any spell or effect
that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text:
The bronze minotaur has advantage on saving
throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapon
traits.text: The bronze minotaur’s weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The bronze minotaur makes two greataxe attacks.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:
23 (3d12 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Breathe Fire (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text:
The bronze minotaur releases a 30-foot
cone of flame. Creatures in the area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving
throw, taking 52 (15d6) fire damage on a failed saving throw, or half as
much damage on a successful one.
